chunks: Abu Baṣīr narrated from Abū Jaʿfar, peace be upon him, who said: I heard him say:
"I dislike for the muhrim to sleep on a yellow mattress or a cushion."

key_terms.أَبُو بَصِيرٍ: Abu Baṣīr, the narrator transmitting the report
key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Jaʿfar, Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.أَكْرَهُ: I regard as disliked; indicates karahah rather than prohibition
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: the person in the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked for a muhrim to sleep on yellow bedding during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith states a disliked act for a person in the state of ihram: sleeping on yellow bedding or a yellow cushion. It reflects a legal etiquette related to outward adornment and restraint during ihram in hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2620 - Abu Basir narrated from Abu Ja'far (as), who said:
"I dislike for a Muhrim to sleep on a yellow mattress or a yellow cushion."
